from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import List, Literal

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information from a single judgment document."""
    title: str = Field(description="The official title of the judgment document as it appears in the text")
    case_type: Literal['民事案件', '执行案件', '刑事案件', '管辖案件', '行政案件'] = Field(description="The case classification based on the task's 5 categories")
    classification_evidence: str = Field(description="Text snippet from the document that justifies the classification (e.g., '民事判决书', '执行复议')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: List[DocumentInfo]
